data.name: caption_text
data.value: Three short steps, and then you can hunt for mistakes. Other people's, of course.

data.name: about_text
data.value: Revit Linter finds issues in projects and families before they reach your drawings or your colleagues: built-in checks, your own YAML rules, collisions and project parameters.

data.name: tab_format
data.value: All commands are on the "{0}" ribbon tab.

data.name: parameters_text
data.value: When a document is opened or created, the add-in adds two shared project parameters to it: Linter_Ignored and Linter_IgnoredType. They store the list of ignored findings, so the model is modified.

data.name: configuration_format
data.value: The rules are YAML files in {0}. Every Revit version has its own folder.

data.name: logs_format
data.value: If something goes wrong, the logs are in {0}.
